Directors Fees & Sitting allowances (Cash) Policy framework
data.0: Directors Fees & Sitting allowances (Cash)

data.item: To attract and retain Non-Executive Directors of the highest calibre and having the necessary skills and expertise to exercise independent judgement on issues that promote the company’s objectives. The directors fees and sitting allowances paid to Non-Executive Directors are determined by the Board of Directors, with recommendations from the Group Nomination and Governance Committee.
data.0: To attract and retain Non-Executive Directors of the highest calibre and having the necessary skills and expertise to exercise independent judgement on issues that promote the company’s objectives.
data.1: The directors fees and sitting allowances paid to Non-Executive Directors are determined by the Board of Directors, with recommendations from the Group Nomination and Governance Committee.

data.item: Members of the various Committees are also eligible to receive an additional sitting allowance fee.
data.1: Members of the various Committees are also eligible to receive an additional sitting allowance fee.

data.item: The fees payable are reviewed periodically by the Group Nomination and Governance Committee to ensure that the fees remain competitive and in line with remuneration of other non- executive directors in the same industry. Time commitment and responsibility are also taken into account when reviewing fees.

data.item: Travel and expenses for Non-Executive Directors (including the Chairman) for company related assignments are all met by the Company.
